preconditions: A derived borehole or structural-observation artifact is projected to a geographic route
decisionLogic: A derived artifact may join a route workspace only when its complete routeBinding object exactly equals the binding independently calculated from the plan route.
uncertainty: The binding proves route identity, not observation accuracy, correlation, lateral support or geological truth.
exclusions: No station-only or visually similar route matching
validationMethod: Positive exact binding, different-route rejection, missing-binding rejection and out-of-route station rejection
reopenCondition: Reopen for a new route CRS, curved route primitive, signed provenance envelope or route-edit migration.
